title: RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LTD – Company Profile
body:
Reliance Industries Limited (RELIANCE.NS) is India’s leading conglomerate with a diversified portfolio spanning petrochemicals, refining, oil & gas, telecom (Jio), retail and digital services. In FY2026, the company generated sales of ₹1,055.78 bn, up 9.65% YoY, driven by robust refining and retail demand. EBITDA margin of 19.69% and net margin of 7.65% underscored efficient cost controls and high‑margin telecom revenues. Earnings per share rose to ₹59.69, reflecting solid free cash flow and disciplined capital allocation.

Reliance’s balance sheet remains solid with equity of ₹904.03 bn versus borrowings of ₹402.96 bn, giving a debt‑to‑equity ratio of 0.45. Cash & bank balances of ₹145.98 bn support ongoing investment and dividend policy. The WACC of 10.73% incorporates a cost of equity of 12.27% and after‑tax cost of debt 5.62%.

DCF analysis values equity at ₹1,107.18 per share, slightly below the current price of ₹1,226, implying a modest 11% premium over intrinsic value. A 3‑year trailing sales CAGR of 14.84% and EBITDA margin range 19.05%–19.69% suggest steady growth momentum.

Risk metrics show a 92% confidence VaR of –1.98%, translating to a worst‑case decline of ₹24.32 per share.

Key highlights:
• 3‑year sales CAGR 14.84%
• EBITDA margin 19.69%
• ROE 9.25%
• ROIC 10.04%
• Equity value per share ₹1,107.18
• Current price ₹1,226
